Its policy is to focus on strengthening the competitive advantage of its core business, accelerate the improvement of the value of human capital and provide high-quality services at appropriate prices, strengthen approaches to manufacturing plants and the like through the solar power generation business, deeply develop pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and the like through validation support, newly develop pharmaceutical and medical facilities and the like through new space decontamination methods, and expand and strengthen overseas development, thereby contributing to the sustainability of customers' business activities. The target figures of the plan are not transcribed here because they are matters concerning the future.
